n=14

def dist_leq(adj,u,v,limit):
    if u==v: return True
    seen=[False]*n; seen[u]=True; q=[u]; depths=[0]
    head=0
    while head < len(q):
        x=q[head]; d=depths[head]; head+=1
        if d==limit: continue
        for y in adj[x]:
            if y==v: return True
            if not seen[y]:
                seen[y]=True; q.append(y); depths.append(d+1)
    return False
